name: Jingle Bell Ornament
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from durable iron with a smooth painted finish.
    - Decorated with festive top embellishments including faux pine branches, red berries, pinecones, and a gingham ribbon bow.
    - Features a sturdy jute rope hanger for easy hanging.
    - Available in 2 classic colors: White and Red.
    - Designed to be lightweight yet durable for seasonal decorating.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 8 x7 cm ~ 3.1 x 2.7 in
    - Compact size makes it suitable for trees, doors, hooks, and decorative displays.
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
    📌 Note:
    - Print placement will be arranged in the most balanced printable area possible.
    - Because product blanks may vary between production batches, the positions of the cutout openings are not fixed.
    - Therefore, print placement may vary slightly and may not be 100% perfectly aligned on every item.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Designed as a personalized Jingle Bell Ornament for holiday decoration.
    - Comes with a jute rope hanger for easy hanging on Christmas trees, doors, walls, or hooks.
    - Iron body provides a sturdy structure with a charming festive appearance.
    - Decorative top accent adds a warm and rustic Christmas touch.
    - Ideal for personalizing with names, short messages, or holiday-themed artwork.
    - A lovely keepsake ornament that can be reused year after year.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Perfect for Christmas, winter holidays, and festive celebrations.
    - A thoughtful gift for family members, friends, couples, kids, and pet lovers.
    - Great for holiday gifting, stocking stuffers, family keepsakes, and Christmas tree decoration.
    - Ideal for commemorating special memories with custom names or photos.
    - A charming personalized gift for home décor lovers and seasonal ornament collectors.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x  Jingle Bell Ornament

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
